title: Production release work
summary: Implementation and rollout tracking. These lanes do not override individual module status or claim a deployed integration.

workstreams.name: PHP application release
workstreams.scope: Clean source revision e5479d3 and a verified 739-file production artifact. Live host promotion is not yet completed.

workstreams.name: Role-aware notifications
workstreams.scope: Workflow recipients, in-app inbox, queued email and delivery handling. Native concurrency and deployed delivery remain separate acceptance steps.

workstreams.name: Payment and remote-session adapters
workstreams.scope: Authenticated provider callbacks, payment lifecycle and scoped remote sessions. Actual merchant and signed-host transports are not yet connected.

workstreams.name: Role and tool workflows
workstreams.scope: Canonical role capabilities and native workflows across 21 profiles, four membership roles and 49 tools. Final integrated rollout is pending.

workstreams.name: Deployment safety
workstreams.scope: Runtime preservation, authenticated transfer, recoverable promotion and guarded migrations.
